description: NaPr₉Si₆(SO₁₂)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.60 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent Pr sites. In the first Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two S and six O atoms. There is one shorter (2.98 Å) and one longer (3.02 Å) Pr-S bond length. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.94 Å. In the second Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two S and six O atoms. There is one shorter (3.02 Å) and one longer (3.03 Å) Pr-S bond length. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-3.13 Å. In the third Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.75 Å. In the fourth Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.77 Å. In the fifth Pr site, Pr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Pr-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.81 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to six Pr atoms to form face-sharing SPr₆ octahedra. In the second S site, S is bonded to six Pr atoms to form face-sharing SPr₆ octahedra. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Pr and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Pr and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Pr and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Pr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Pr and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Pr and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Pr and one Si atom.
